test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 29 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Pointing to Jayant, Gita said 'He is the only son of Rajbir, who has two sisters and one of them is Anshika". Dhroov is the brother of Geetam. Rajbir is the paternal grandfather of Geetam, who is the daughter of Gita. Then how Jayant is related to Gita?
solution:
**Explanation:**

Preparing the family according to the following symbols.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83adf6b34f0e218dde4887ea242cc7167544bfc9aae7d856eb6cd0466f75bda0.png] 

Pointing to Jayant, Gita said : "Jayant is the only son of, Rajbir."

Rajbir who has two sisters and one of them is Anshika

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/49591e94d9fe9bfc7f6735a5d8d1996489669730991f1b1e1459f5f818577149.png] 

 

Rajbir is the paternal grandfather of Geetam, **who** is the daughter of Gita. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/66b86600c2addcdbf4417cdb5d7cd2e1d5d149e2af18366bb35ad7d8bae9264c.png] 

Dhroov is the brother of Geetam [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ab154757db7547ef4853607c8d08aa04080a95ef554064825a72b6a5986e6f72.png] 

According to the family tree, Jayant is husband of Gita.

**Hence, the correct answer is option 1.**
